Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1176
Claimant:
James Roth
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
5-14-25
Side impact reported at an intersection. The insured vehicle was struck on the driver's side by another car. Police
attended the scene and confirmed the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the time.
6-2-25
Claimant is represented by counsel, and all contact is now routed through the attorney's office. Photos from the scene
confirm some details of the collision, though no independent witnesses have come forward.
6-4-25
Vehicle inspection completed. Damage is mostly consistent with the described impact, and no earlier damage to the
vehicle is known. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage.
6-19-25
Reviewing the policy, the driver at the time of loss is listed as a person who is not permitted to drive the insured
vehicle. Referred the matter to the coverage team for review before any further decision is made.
9-7-25
Claimant reports a knee injury from the collision. Medical records show treatment followed a usual course and eased
off as the patient improved. No earlier injury to the same area is known, but it is not yet clear whether this crash
caused the injury.
9-21-25
Claimant's account has been taken again through counsel. Some small details were added since the first statement,
but the core account has stayed the same. File remains open pending the coverage review and the medical
assessment.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
